verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a video generation model, since community comments note open-source alternatives like Wan and Hunyuan exist. However, the evidence only shows Veo offered as a hosted service (the Gemini API, Gemini and Flow apps, and GCP credits). Nothing documents downloadable weights or an on-premises deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
